name: Girls on a Train
source:
On a train heading into Cummingbrook, you have work to do and deadlines to reach.

But, fuck! The battery on your headphones has just died, and the two beautiful girls sitting across from you are a super cute distraction! And their conversation is getting... weird!

What would you do if you found yourself sitting opposite scheming little Effy and her sexy sister Steph, and they decided it'd be fun to mess with you in the naughtiest way possible? Especially if you're socially awkward but horny!

And just who else riding the train will notice their evil little games in this sequel to [url=/v35114]A Girl on a Train[/url]?
